Anna Hazare comments on CJP protest ending, cites non-violence

Social activist Anna Hazare commented on the conclusion of a protest organized by the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP). Hazare stated that he has undertaken 22 hunger strikes in the past and has never resorted to violence. He emphasized that democracy does not equate to dictatorship. The CJP protest has now ended.
